newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti confirms Omnitel stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti confirms Omnitel stake sale.

text.p: Olivetti confirmed its intention to dispose of eight percent of Omnitel Sistemi Radiocellulari but said this would not affect Olivetti's control of the company.

Omnitel Pronto Italia managing director Silvio Scaglia said earlier on Thursday that the mobile telephone operator, in which Olivetti has a 41.3 percent stake, was in talks with Mannesmann that could lead to the German firm raising its stake in Omnitel Sistemi Radiocellulari, which owns 70 percent of Omnitel Pronto Italia.
Olivetti chief executive Roberto Colaninno confirmed the aim to sell the eight percent stake at a meeting with analysts this evening.
Olivetti corporate finance director Luciano La Noce added that the disposal "does not affect the preservation of control (of Omnitel) and increases its coffers and resources."
Mannesmann currently holds a relatively small indirect stake in Omnitel Pronto Italia.
